items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: When I went over Mrs. Clow said, 'Helen you have the most beautiful clothes. I can't understand how you can manage on your salary'

ctx.x:

come back they leave them right over there. You come on over here and we'll get you some gorgeous things. And I sure did. When I went over Mrs. Clow said, 'Helen you have the most beautiful clothes. I can't understand how you can manage on your salary'. I said, 'well I had some clothes before I got here Miss Clow. And she said, 'they are beautiful'.
So that was the beginning. That was your first taste of the public eye.
